results.content: A few reviews and surveys limited their literature analysis to the application of federated learning in the medical field [53,54,55], lacking technical insight; others, due to the broad scope of the review and survey papers, dedicated less than 900 words to discuss machine learning-based methods for medical image analysis [56,57,58,59,60], which is the main focus of our review. results.title: Transforming healthcare: the impact of artificial intelligence ...
results.content: Transforming healthcare: the impact of artificial intelligence on diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, and ethical considerations – a comprehensive review Artificial intelligence (AI) integration has arisen as a prominent technology in the healthcare sector, transforming the field by advancing early diagnostics, surgeries, and ethical concerns. *   Artificial intelligence (AI) improves diagnostics via machine learning for predictive and disease analytics. AI uses advanced machine learning (ML) algorithms to identify trends in these datasets, allowing for early disease detection and personalized treatment regimens. AI-powered genomic analysis and predictive modeling allow healthcare practitioners to create customized treatment regimens based on a patient’s genetic makeup and medical history. This type of healthcare system uses big original data sets regarding the patients’ conditions, where live updates of their conditions are checked, and the treatment is proceeded by logical and highly successful AI assistants[10].
